title: Moscow, 6 July 1940: two weather observations in the June-October tables
caption: The only enciphered Soviet broadcast copied in the Japanese reports: two stations received on 6 July 1940 at 04:00 Japan time, key group 22244 (row 222, column 44 of table 3), deciphered by subtracting the 109-figure cycle from that point (JACAR C01004832600, image 4). Twelve groups, 60 figures, all 60 certain; the clear groups are synoptic weather figures, not words.
key_note: Table 3 of the Moscow tables of June 1940 as transcribed from the report of 16 July 1940 (targets/moscowmeteo1940/tables_1940.py); 7 and X are exchanged before the key figures are subtracted without carrying; the second station continues in the same 109-figure cycle. The clear text is the international synoptic code (station index, cloud, weather, wind, pressure, temperature).
